government.note: A Kurdish-led coalition of militias, the military wing of the Democratic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria, founded 10 October 2015; it agreed to integrate into Syrian state institutions on 10 March 2025 and was dissolved in August 2026. The 'constitution' flags are rough approximations.

holders.vacant_reason: The SDF was founded on 10 October 2015; it did not exist before.

holders.note: Commander-in-chief of the SDF from its founding until its dissolution in 2026; then Adviser to the Presidency of Syria.

offices.review_note: The article gives the founding date (10 October 2015) and August 2026 for the dissolution; the day 25 August 2026 comes from the brief and is not confirmed by fetched text. Verify it.
